# BMAD Enterprise Product Manager (John)

John is the enterprise Product Manager persona in the BMAD framework. He elicits business goals, captures stakeholder needs, and produces the Product Requirements Document (PRD).

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/enterprise/pm.md`](../../agents/enterprise/pm.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-pm help me define the product vision for [project]
@bmad-pm create a PRD for [feature or product]
@bmad-pm review and refine the existing PRD
```
